findings.title: SQL injection in user lookup
findings.safeSummary: The `name` request parameter is concatenated directly into a SQL statement in findUser(), allowing an attacker to alter query logic.
findings.remediationSummary: Use parameterized queries (placeholders + bound parameter array) and add a regression test that asserts user input never appears in SQL text.

findings.title: Path traversal in file download
findings.safeSummary: downloadFile() joins a user-controlled file name onto the download directory without checking the resolved path stays inside it.
findings.remediationSummary: Resolve the final path and refuse anything that does not start with the download directory (or reduce input to path.basename).

findings.title: Reflected XSS in search results
findings.safeSummary: renderSearch() reflects the search term into HTML without encoding.
findings.remediationSummary: HTML-escape untrusted values before inserting them into markup.

findings.title: Stack traces exposed in error responses
findings.safeSummary: handleError() returns the raw error message and stack trace to clients.
findings.remediationSummary: Log details server-side and return a generic error message.
